card.name: Small words in news and story narration
card.fires_on: Common small words (verbs like keeping, worship, believed; also a, only, always, for, about) in general web narrative prose such as news stories and personal accounts. The word is usually one that expects a purpose or description phrase to follow.

modes.label: Purpose or reason verbs
modes.description: A verb or -ing form introducing a purpose or belief, such as keeping, worship or believed.
modes.example: It is posted on the Urban Gateway by way of<< keeping>> all users informed about matters of interest.

modes.label: Linking words in narrated stories
modes.description: Short words like a, only, always, for, about inside first-person or charity-story narration.
modes.example: The individuals who work on the Amazing Turk site often do so just<< for>> fun.

card.plain: It lights up on ordinary small words in storytelling prose, just before a purpose or description is given.
